h1: [smooth, warm, late-night TV host] Good evening, Miami. I'm Vince Velour. Tonight I'll teach you to live like it's nineteen eighty-six... for FREE.
h2: [big showman voice] Give it up for our studio AUDIENCE!
fh2: [dry] The live audience had a resort FEE.
h3: [cool, pointing at the camera] Roll the INTRO!
l1: [teacher voice, tapping a chalkboard] Lesson one. PARKING. Step one: confidence.
l2: [sly, teaching] Step two. If you never stop... it's not PARKING.
l3: [excited] Step three. Find the FREE spot.
l4: [proud, then a beat] And that's how I got a free ride... HOME.
fl1: [deadpan] Honey. Your car is behind you.
rl1: [chill, waving] Storage is by the DAY, amigo.
rc1: [warm infomercial voice] Tired of looking for parking? Let Rey PARK you.
rc2: [calm, proud, slightly menacing] Rey's Towing. We find you. You don't find US.
xc1: [extremely fast legal disclaimer, rushed monotone] Parking free, ride three-fifty, storage daily, fees may apply, Rey not liable, Rey not sorry.
m1: [host, confident] Lesson two. MONEY. In nineteen eighty-six, cash was KING.
m2: [confident, smug] So I invested... in BOATS.
m3: [proud] Net result: I'm a licensed... TOW truck.
xr1: [seductive luxury car commercial voice] Introducing ROOF-E Premium. Rain? Subscribe.
xr2: [seductive, slow] Sun? Subscribe. Doors? Coming SOON.
xr3: [whispering, dramatic] ROOF-E. You don't own the SKY.
c1: [excited host] We're taking CALLS! Line one, you're on nineteen eighty-six!
tc1: [monotone, bored] Hi. There's a calling fee. Bye.
gc1: [suspicious, pompous] Vince? Why are you on TV? You called in SICK.
c3: [fake coughing, weak voice] It's a... medical show, Gary. [coughs]
dc1: [gruff, official] Sir. Your show is broadcasting without a license. Two-fifty.
c5: [exasperated, almost crying] Is ANYONE calling just to say HI?!
d1: [dramatic host] Lesson three. PATIENCE. The game dropped on Thursday.
d2: [bitter, tired] I'm still on the loading SCREEN.
f1: [warm closing, sentimental] So remember, Miami. In nineteen eighty-six, everything was simple—
xf1: [chipper, robotic] To continue watching nineteen eighty-six, subscribe to Premium. Nine ninety-nine.
xf2: [chipper, robotic] Plus a three-fifty CONVENIENCE fee.
ff1: [deadpan, dry punchline] Honey. Even nineteen eighty-six is a subscription now.
f4: [slow, quiet, taking off his sunglasses, to the camera] ...Be kind. REWIND.
s1: [host, very cool] Lesson four. STYLE. A real man drives with the top DOWN.
s2: [proud, then quietly sad] And now it stays down... for nineteen ninety-nine a month.
k1: [host, conspiratorial whisper to camera] Lesson five. CAREER. Never let your boss see you in LINE.
k2: [smug] Unless he's in line TOO. Then you're FAMILY.
